opening.argument: The presentation solicits paid mining memberships through packages with prices and “Buy Now” buttons. It describes a one-time buy-in as providing “passive income basically for life,” while a $3,500 purchase is said to provide mining-pool shares, a thousand days of mining, and a share of profits. The speaker further states that “50% of what you receive from your share is automatically reinvested in the company.” A conditional estimate that viewers will “probably make your money back in a year at the current rates” presents the purchase as potentially recoverable within a year. The urgency is explicit: the founder’s pool is said to be available only through month-end, followed by a recommendation to buy in immediately. The regulatory disclaimer and rejection of a quick-rich scheme qualify the pitch, but do not change its core solicitation of paid memberships for promised mining returns.

citations.quote: This is a one-time buy-in that gives you passive income basically for life
50% of what you receive from your share is automatically reinvested in the company
you'll probably make your money back in a year at the current rates
I highly recommend that if you've got the money, even five hundred dollars, buy in now.
